notes: Produced a controller with moderate speed and PID gains tuned for the 5-sensor layout, using weighted sensor inputs to steer effectively. Line loss recovery set to last known direction to improve robustness. Observation requests match those needed to evaluate line following and stability.
rationale: The geometry provides a balanced and stable platform with a 5-sensor array evenly spaced across the front, moderate sensor size, and balanced body dimensions. To complement this, the controller uses a moderate base speed to balance speed and control, and PID gains tuned to respond effectively to the sensor signals. Sensor weights are set to steer the robot towards the line center, with stronger weights on the outer sensors to correct larger deviations. The line loss strategy is set to 'last_direction' to continue turning in the last known direction of the line, aiding recovery. Observation requests include completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and max_error to evaluate line following performance and stability.
